annotations.title: Check an SPF, DMARC or DKIM record before publishing it

description: Use when you or the user are about to publish or edit an SPF, DMARC or DKIM TXT record, for example after writing a new SPF record that adds a sending service, or when the user pastes a record and asks "is this right?". Detects the record type. SPF: syntax per RFC 7208, every include and redirect followed live in DNS and counted against the 10-lookup limit, void lookups, loops, the final all; returns a lookup tree. DMARC: RFC 7489 tags and values (p, sp, pct, rua/ruf, adkim/aspf, fo). DKIM: key type and RSA key size read from the key, revoked (empty p=) or truncated keys. Returns valid true/false, errors, warnings and where to publish it. Pass domain so a/mx terms without a value can be resolved.

domain.description: Optional: the domain the record is for, so SPF a and mx terms can be checked.

record.description: The TXT record value, e.g. "v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all" or "v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@mycompany.com". Quoted chunks ("..." "...") are joined.

name: stamp_check_dns_record
title: Check an SPF, DMARC or DKIM record before publishing it
